name: Echoing Soul
summary: Ravenloft Dark Gift. Two skills, a language and an Expertise you can move each Long Rest; a natural 1 can leave you Incapacitated and slow.

benefits.name: Channeled Prowess
benefits.text: Two skills of your choice become proficient.

benefits.name: Channeled Prowess (Expertise)
benefits.summary: Expertise in one skill you're proficient in; you can change it when you finish a Long Rest.
benefits.text: Choose one skill in which you have proficiency; you have Expertise in it. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can choose a different skill instead.

benefits.name: Inherent Tongues
benefits.text: You learn one extra language of your choice from the Player's Handbook tables.

drawback.name: Intrusive Echoes
drawback.summary: On a natural 1: Constitution save (DC 13 + PB) or Incapacitated, at half Speed, until the end of your next turn.
drawback.text: Right after a D20 Test shows a 1 on the d20, the other life in you surges: make a Constitution save (DC 13 + your Proficiency Bonus). Fail, and you are Incapacitated with your Speed halved until the end of your next turn.
